feature_request: Add password validation to the login system. Require at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. Also add tests for valid and invalid passwords.
acceptance_criteria: The login system rejects passwords with fewer than 8 characters
The login system rejects passwords that do not contain at least one uppercase letter
The login system rejects passwords that do not contain at least one number
The login system rejects passwords that do not contain at least one special character
New tests verify that all specified valid password inputs are accepted
